body.en: When dealing with massive code diffs and long-running monitoring tasks, command-line responsiveness and resource management are much more reliable. Terminal rendering performance is improved so large diffs and long transcripts render faster with fewer frame drops. Startup time is slightly reduced by skipping redundant validation of built-in model data. Monitor watches now enforce a mandatory deadline (at most 30 minutes in regular sessions, 10 minutes in single-prompt `-p` runs) and notify Claude to re-arm, replacing the previous no-timeout persistent option. Fixed an issue on Windows where PowerShell commands failed with "Exit code 1" and no output when the session temp output path reached the 260-character limit. ⟦This is like replacing an old projector with a high-refresh display so paging through massive diffs no longer stutters, while monitoring equipment is fitted with safety timers that report regularly.⟧

items.original:
Improved terminal rendering performance: large diffs and long transcripts render faster, with fewer slow frames
Improved startup time slightly by skipping a redundant validation of built-in model data on every launch
Changed Monitor watches to always have a deadline (at most 30 minutes; 10 in single-prompt `-p` runs) and notify Claude to re-arm, replacing the no-timeout `persistent` option
Windows: Fixed PowerShell commands failing with "Exit code 1" and no output when the session's temp output path reaches 260 characters

title.zh-TW: LLM 閘道相容純文字回應，切換目錄精確重計技能
title.en: LLM Gateways Support Plaintext Replies, Skill Counts Stay Accurate After Directory Changes

body.zh-TW: 串接大型語言模型閘道器或切換工作目錄時，資料格式解析與環境清理更為精準。當大型語言模型（LLM）閘道器將非串流回覆以 `text/plain` 純文字格式返回時，對話回合不再報錯為空回應或格式損毀。執行 `/cd` 切換目錄後，`/reload-skills` 回報的技能數量與斜線選單完全一致。引用 PDF 檔案時若無法計算頁數，會明確標註「頁數未知」，不再根據檔案大小猜測。Claude 應用程式閘道器與第三方雲端平台（Bedrock、Vertex AI、Foundry）的工作階段，不再刷新多餘且未使用的 claude.ai 登入狀態。⟦這好似快遞分揀機即使收到純文字包裹也能順利送達，更換工作目錄後技能數量依然精準清點，不再殘留多餘的登入狀態。⟧
body.en: Connecting through LLM gateways or switching directories now features more accurate formatting and environment cleanup. When an LLM gateway returns non-streaming replies as `text/plain`, turns no longer fail with empty or malformed response errors. After changing directories via `/cd`, `/reload-skills` reports a skill count that perfectly matches the slash menu. When referencing PDF files where page count cannot be determined, it explicitly notes "page count unknown" rather than guessing based on file size. Sessions on the Claude apps gateway and third-party cloud platforms (Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry) no longer refresh unused leftover claude.ai logins. ⟦This is like a package sorter reliably delivering plain-text parcels, while changing workspaces keeps tool counts accurate without leaving redundant login sessions behind.⟧

items.original:
Fixed turns failing with "API returned an empty or malformed response" when an LLM gateway returns the non-streaming reply as `text/plain`
Fixed `/reload-skills` reporting a skill count that disagreed with the slash menu after `/cd`
Improved PDF @-mentions to say "page count unknown" instead of a page count guessed from the file size when pdfinfo cannot count the pages
Changed Claude apps gateway, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry sessions so that they no longer refresh a leftover claude.ai login that the session does not use

title.zh-TW: 工作階段運行已久時，唯讀 Git 指令不再誤跳授權詢問
title.en: Read-only Git commands no longer mistakenly prompt for permission during long-running sessions

body.zh-TW: 當你長時間開啟工作階段（從開啟工具到結束對話的完整操作過程）處理專案時，如果只想查閱檔案紀錄，最怕流程莫名被打斷。⟦這好比在賣場貨架前翻看商品背面的成分說明，你既沒有拆封也沒有推走貨品，店員卻在你逛了一陣子後，每拿一瓶就突然上前要求你出示證件簽名。⟧在先前的 2.1.269 版本中，工具就出現了這項令人困擾的退步問題。當時只要你在 Bash（在黑底白字視窗裡輸入文字指令的運作環境）中持續操作了一段時間，原本完全不更動任何檔案的 Git 唯讀指令，就會出乎意料地彈出確認提示，反覆向你要求授權。特別是像 Git 這種用來追蹤檔案修改歷程的工具，其查詢狀態或檢視歷史的指令純粹只是讀取資料，本就不該頻繁索取權限。這項問題現在已經修好，往後即使工作階段持續運行，各類唯讀指令也能順暢完成，不再出現多餘的授權詢問來打斷你的思路。
body.en: When you keep a session open for a long time to work on a project and simply want to inspect file history, having your workflow randomly interrupted is frustrating. ⟦It is like browsing store shelves to check the ingredient labels on the back of products—without opening any packaging or taking items away, yet after you have shopped for a while, a clerk suddenly walks up and demands your ID and signature every single time you pick up a bottle.⟧ In the previous 2.1.269 release, the tool suffered from this frustrating regression. Back then, after operating for a while in Bash, read-only Git commands that modify no files at all would unexpectedly trigger confirmation prompts and repeatedly demand permission. Especially for a tool like Git used to track file modification history, commands that inspect status or view history purely read data and should never demand permissions so frequently. This issue has now been resolved; going forward, even when a session runs continuously, various read-only commands complete smoothly without unnecessary permission prompts interrupting your flow.

items.original: Fixed read-only git commands in Bash unexpectedly asking for permission after a session had been running for a while (regression in 2.1.269)

title.zh-TW: GPT-6-Astra 上架模型挑選器與 Bedrock，官方文件同步補上轉移指引
title.en: GPT-6-Astra Arrives in Model Picker and Bedrock with Updated Migration Guides

body.zh-TW: 開發時想嘗試最新一代模型？現在進入模型挑選器（model picker，供切換不同 AI 版本的選單）即可直接選用 GPT-6-Astra。這項更新也同步推送到 Amazon Bedrock 的服務目錄中。若你正打算將既有專案遷移過來，內建的 OpenAI Docs 技能也已全面更新，針對 GPT-6-Astra 提供專門的轉移步驟、相容性說明與提示詞撰寫指引。⟦這就像車商正式將新旗艦車款陳列在展示中心與特約經銷商的型錄上，同時隨車手冊也立即換上新版的升級指南、相容說明與駕駛操作技巧。⟧無論你透過本機選單還是雲端目錄調用，都能直接對照指引順利切換。
body.en: Looking to try the latest model during development? You can now select GPT-6-Astra directly from the model picker. This update is also available in the Amazon Bedrock service catalog. If you plan to migrate existing projects, the bundled OpenAI Docs skill has been updated with dedicated migration steps, compatibility notes, and prompting guidance for GPT-6-Astra. ⟦It is like a carmaker showcasing a new flagship model in showrooms and dealership catalogs, while immediately updating the owner's manual with upgrade guides, compatibility details, and driving tips.⟧ Whether you invoke it from the local menu or cloud catalog, you can switch smoothly by following the guides.

items.original:
GPT-6-Astra is now available in the model picker and Amazon Bedrock catalogs. (#42879, #42619)
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs skill with GPT-6-Astra migration, compatibility, and prompting guidance. (#42931)

title.zh-TW: 實驗性工作樹支援登場，獨立簽出目錄支援瀏覽與續接
title.en: Experimental Worktree Support Arrives to Browse and Resume Isolated Checkouts

body.zh-TW: 你想同時處理多條開發分支又不想弄亂現有目錄？Codex 新增了實驗性的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）支援。⟦這恰似圖書館為大型研究計畫增設獨立自修室，研究員可以帶著資料副本到專用房間閉門作業，中途可以走出房間瀏覽各室進度，稍後也能重新進房接續未完的研究，完全不會佔用大廳的公共閱覽桌。⟧現在只要在啟動時加上 `--worktree` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/worktree` 指令，就能為全新或分支衍生出的工作階段建立彼此隔離的簽出目錄。建立之後，你還能隨心瀏覽所有存在的工作樹，並重新續接先前的工作進度。
body.en: Want to work on multiple branches simultaneously without cluttering your current directory? Codex now introduces experimental worktree support. ⟦This is like a library setting up private study rooms for major research projects, allowing researchers to work behind closed doors with copies of materials, step out to browse progress across rooms, and return later to resume unfinished work without occupying shared reading tables.⟧ Simply pass the `--worktree` flag at startup or enter the `/worktree` command in a conversation to create isolated checkout directories for new or forked sessions. Once created, you can browse all existing worktrees and resume earlier progress at any time.

items.original: Experimental worktree support lets you create isolated checkouts for new or forked sessions using `--worktree` or `/worktree`, then browse and resume them. (#42652, #43069, #43120, #43286)

title.zh-TW: 背景執行中直接行內回答提問，提供建議選項且不丟失草稿
title.en: Answer Questions Inline While Working in Background Without Losing Drafts

body.zh-TW: 請 Codex 寫程式的同時，你不再需要被動等待它停下才能互動。當它在背景持續運作並向你提出疑問時，現在能直接在行內（inline，直接在當前內容中插入顯示）彈出提問並即時作答。⟦宛如主廚在料理台上全神貫注烹調主菜時，助手從旁遞上調味選擇的便條，主廚能順手打勾或寫上備註，手中的主菜鍋鏟完全不需停下。⟧你可以直接點選介面給出的建議選項，也能自行輸入自訂文字回答。更重要的是，這項互動完全不會清空或影響你原本在輸入框中打到一半的主草稿，確保思緒與進度雙軌推進。
body.en: You no longer have to wait idly for Codex to stop before interacting while it writes code. When Codex runs in the background and asks a question, it can now surface prompt questions inline for immediate replies. ⟦Just like an assistant handing seasoning option slips to a chef focused on cooking a main dish, allowing the chef to check boxes or jot notes without ever putting down the spatula.⟧ You can click suggested options provided by the interface or type custom text responses. Best of all, this interaction will not clear or affect your ongoing main draft in the input box, keeping both your thoughts and progress on track.

items.original: Answer questions inline while Codex continues working, using suggested choices or custom text without losing your main draft. (#42891, #42894, #42897)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援共享背景伺服器，提供守護行程管理指令與自動更新
title.en: Windows Adds Shared Background Server with Daemon Lifecycle Commands and Managed Updates

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境上使用 Codex，多個工作階段現在能共用同一個背景運行的伺服器，不必每個終端機視窗各自啟動一份。這次更新同步引入了守護行程（daemon，在背景持續默默提供服務的常駐程式）生命週期管理指令，讓你能查詢狀態、啟動或終止背景伺服器，同時還納入了託管更新機制，確保背景服務能平順接收後續升級。⟦這好比集合式辦公大樓設置中央公用影印列印中心，各樓層辦公室共用同一組背景運轉的專業主機與管理工具，不必每張桌子都各自擺一台高耗能印表機。⟧
body.en: Multiple sessions on Windows can now share a single background server instead of each terminal window starting its own. This update also introduces daemon lifecycle management commands to check status, start, or stop the background server, alongside managed updates to ensure background services receive future upgrades smoothly. ⟦This is like an office building setting up a central printing center where offices on each floor share the same background professional equipment and management tools, rather than placing power-hungry printers on every desk.⟧

items.original: Windows sessions can now share a background Codex server, with daemon lifecycle commands and managed updates. (#42405, #42392)

title.zh-TW: Vim 編輯新增 R 取代模式，支援復原與重複操作並改善退出鍵
title.en: Vim Editing Adds R Replace Mode with Undo, Dot-Repeat, and Reliable Escape Handling

body.zh-TW: 習慣 Vim 鍵盤操作的開發者，在編輯草稿時手感將更加俐落。這次更新為 Vim 模式補上了經典的 `R` 取代模式，讓你可以直接覆蓋游標處的字元。進行文字替換時，你能按鍵復原（undo，回復到修改前的文字），也能利用小數點鍵重複執行上一次的取代動作。針對舊型終端機，更新也改善了 Escape 鍵的訊號處理，讓跳離編輯模式的操作更可靠，避免按鍵延遲或失靈。⟦此舉有如手寫打字機具備了即時覆蓋色帶，既能直接壓字修正錯別字，又能藉由倒退鍵復原上一步或連打重複印字，同時也把老舊按鍵卡榫徹底潤滑修好。⟧
body.en: Developers accustomed to Vim keybindings will enjoy a snappier draft editing experience. This update brings the classic `R` replace mode to Vim mode, allowing you to overwrite characters directly under the cursor. During text replacement, you can undo changes and use the dot key to repeat your previous replacement action. For legacy terminals, the update improves Escape key handling, making exiting edit modes more reliable and avoiding key delays or failures. ⟦This is like a typewriter equipped with an instant correction ribbon that overwrites typos, allows backspacing to undo or repeating keystrokes, while fully lubricating worn-out mechanical key joints.⟧

items.original: Vim editing gains `R` replace mode with undo and dot-repeat, plus more reliable Escape handling in legacy terminals. (#42194, #42584)

title.zh-TW: 複製回覆保留富文字格式，/copy 指令支援狀態與欄位擷取
title.en: Copying Responses Preserves Rich-Text Formatting as /copy Gains Status and Field Extraction

body.zh-TW: 將對話產生的程式碼或說明貼到其他文書軟體時，排版不再被打亂成純文字了。現在從 Codex 複製回覆內容，貼入支援富文字（rich-text，包含粗體、標題與程式碼區塊等排版樣式）的應用程式時，會完整保留原本的格式外觀。與此同時，命令列工具的 `/copy` 指令也迎來功能強化，除了複製回覆本身，現在還能單獨複製狀態輸出，或是擷取工作階段內的特定個別欄位。⟦一如專業相機輸出照片，既能直接沖洗出帶有完整色彩與層次細節的精緻相片，也可以單獨將相機當前的拍攝數據或特定參數獨立匯出備查。⟧這讓整理文件與分享除錯資訊變得更順暢。
body.en: Pasting generated code or explanations into other document apps will no longer scramble formatting into plain text. Copying responses from Codex into rich-text applications now fully preserves the original styling and appearance. Meanwhile, the command-line `/copy` command has been enhanced to copy status output or extract specific individual fields from a session in addition to the response itself. ⟦Just like a professional camera outputting photos, which can develop fine prints with full color and tonal detail, or independently export current shooting metadata and specific parameters for reference.⟧ This makes organizing documentation and sharing debugging information much smoother.

items.original: Copying responses preserves formatting in rich-text apps, and `/copy` can copy status output or individual session fields. (#42847, #43055)

title.zh-TW: 現有工作階段動態辨識外掛工具，升級回捲自動重新整理
title.en: Existing Sessions Dynamically Detect Plugin Tools and Refresh on Upgrades or Rollbacks

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊的工作階段正在進行，外部外掛有了變更也不需要關掉重開。⟦這如同工廠的工具旋轉吊架，在技師開工期間若由後勤人員掛上新零件或替換工具規格，技師不必停工重開電閘，轉身就能直接拿取最新到貨的工具與操作手冊。⟧既有的工作階段現在具備動態感知能力，能在不中斷執行的情況下，即刻辨識剛安裝好的外掛工具。當外掛在外部完成升級或執行版本回捲時，當前視窗會立即重新整理相應的技能。連同內部定義的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）也會一併更新，確保所有自動化流程即時生效。
body.en: When your current session is running, you no longer need to restart it when external plugins change. ⟦This is like a factory rotating tool rack where logistics staff hang new parts or replace tool specifications while technicians work, allowing technicians to grab newly arrived tools and manuals without shutting down power or halting work.⟧ Existing sessions now feature dynamic detection to recognize newly installed plugin tools without interrupting execution. When plugins are upgraded or rolled back externally, the active window immediately refreshes corresponding skills. Internally defined hooks are updated as well, ensuring all automated workflows take effect immediately.

items.original: Existing sessions pick up newly installed plugin tools and refresh skills and hooks after external plugin upgrades or rollbacks. (#42284, #42593, #42990)

title.zh-TW: MCP 連線協調權杖更新與登入挑戰，舊版伺服器啟動入口退場
title.en: MCP Connections Coordinate Token Refreshes and Login Challenges as Legacy Entry Point Retires

body.zh-TW: 透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）串接外部服務時，授權憑證的維護現在更安全且井然有序。當多個工具連線需要更新 OAuth 授權權杖（token，用來驗證身分的授權令牌）時，Codex 會統一協調這些連線的更新動作。若更新失敗，介面會主動跳出登入驗證挑戰提示，絕不自動重播先前已被拒絕的工具呼叫。此外，先前已被標記為棄用的 `codex mcp-server` 啟動入口也在本次更新中正式移除。⟦猶如園區更新外包廠商的門禁機制，廠商證件過期時由系統集中協調換證，換證失敗即引導人員臨櫃重新認證，絕不拿遭拒的舊卡重複硬刷閘門；同時管理處也正式封閉已張貼告示的舊側門。⟧
body.en: Maintaining authorization credentials when connecting to external services via MCP is now safer and more orderly. When multiple tool connections require OAuth token refreshes, Codex coordinates the refresh across those connections. If a refresh fails, the interface surfaces login challenges without automatically replaying previously rejected tool calls. In addition, the previously deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is officially removed in this release. ⟦This is like an office park updating contractor access control, where expired badges are renewed through centralized coordination, failed renewals direct personnel to service counters for re-verification without repeatedly swiping rejected cards at gates, and management seals off the deprecated side entrance.⟧

items.original:
MCP connections coordinate OAuth token refreshes and surface login challenges when refresh fails, without automatically replaying rejected tool calls. (#42413, #42552)
The deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is no longer available. (#42993)

title.zh-TW: 啟動流程阻擋未信任輔助程式，macOS 沙盒嚴防終端機注入
title.en: Startup Blocks Untrusted Workspace Helpers as macOS Sandbox Prevents Terminal Injection

body.zh-TW: 開啟陌生專案目錄或在蘋果電腦上執行終端機，資安防線在開工當下就已全面就位。現在 Codex 在啟動過程中，若尚未與當前工作區建立明確的信任關係，會主動避免執行任何由工作區控制的輔助程式，杜絕惡意腳本趁虛而入。與此同時，macOS 系統下的沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護層）也經過強化，能確實阻擋未經許可的終端機輸入注入攻擊。⟦這好似進入高度管制的實驗室，外部帶來的隨身器材在通過信任檢驗前一律禁止插電啟動，而隔離艙門的防護隔板也能阻擋外界未授權的按鈕信號干擾。⟧這讓你在檢視未知程式碼時能受到更周密的保護。
body.en: When opening unfamiliar project directories or running terminals on Mac computers, security defenses are active right from the start. During startup, Codex actively avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before establishing trust with the current workspace, preventing malicious scripts from taking advantage. Meanwhile, the macOS sandbox has been strengthened to block unauthorized terminal input injection attacks. ⟦This is like entering a high-security laboratory where personal equipment brought from outside cannot be powered on before trust verification, while containment barriers block unauthorized external button signals.⟧ This ensures thorough protection when inspecting unknown code.

items.original: Startup avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before trust is established, and the macOS sandbox blocks terminal input injection. (#42324, #42590)

title.zh-TW: 遠端續接與分支保留已存權限，新工作階段尊重預設模型
title.en: Remote Resume and Fork Preserve Saved Permissions While Fresh Sessions Follow Default Models

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端環境接續或分流既有進度時，設定與權限將維持一致。當你針對遠端工作階段執行續接（resume，接續先前中斷的進度）或分支操作時，先前已經儲存的授權與權限設定現在會完整延續，省去反覆確認授權的打擾。同時，全新開啟的工作階段以及衍生的分支，除非你在指令中明確指定其他模型，否則一律會嚴格遵守伺服器端配置的預設模型規格。⟦正如跨國企業指派主管遠端接管或分流專案小組，原有的門禁通行權限會自動跟隨繼承，而新立案的分支部門也會直接套用總部規範的標準設備，不必每次連線都重新簽呈。⟧此舉確保了跨端協同作業的權限延續性與環境規範。
body.en: Configurations and permissions remain consistent when resuming or branching progress in remote environments. When performing resume or fork operations on remote sessions, previously saved authorizations and permission settings are preserved, eliminating repetitive authorization prompts. Furthermore, fresh sessions and derived forks strictly respect server-configured default models unless you explicitly specify another model in your command. ⟦Just as a multinational enterprise assigns managers to take over or split project teams remotely, existing access permissions are automatically inherited, while newly chartered branch units adopt standard equipment prescribed by headquarters without requiring new approvals for each connection.⟧ This ensures permission continuity and environmental standards during remote collaboration.

items.original: Remote resume and fork operations preserve saved permissions; fresh sessions and forks respect server model defaults unless explicitly overridden. (#43330, #43177, #43355)

title.zh-TW: 跨應用程式續接對話防衝突，提供唯讀逐字紀錄且保留草稿
title.en: Cross-App Conversation Resume Prevents Conflicts with Read-Only Transcripts and Draft Preservation

body.zh-TW: 當你想接續處理某個對話，但該對話正巧在另一個應用程式中開啟時，現在不必再擔心進度衝突了。⟦彷彿走進銀行閱覽保管箱資料，若另一位共同持有者正在櫃檯查閱正本，行員會先為你提供唯讀對照副本與等候重試號碼牌，並妥善看管你正在填寫的申請表格。⟧Codex 會在介面上顯示唯讀的對話轉錄（transcript，完整對話逐字紀錄），讓你能回顧過往脈絡，並附上重新嘗試的按鈕選項。與此同時，你當前輸入框中正在撰寫的文字草稿也會受到完整保護，不會被清空或覆蓋，方便你在另一端釋放鎖定後立刻接手。
body.en: You no longer have to worry about progress conflicts when resuming a conversation that happens to be open in another application. ⟦It is like visiting a bank vault to inspect documents where, if a co-owner is reviewing the original at the counter, the clerk provides a read-only reference copy and a retry ticket while safeguarding the application form you are filling out.⟧ Codex displays a read-only transcript in the interface so you can review past context, accompanied by a retry button option. Meanwhile, your ongoing text draft in the input box remains protected without being cleared or overwritten, allowing you to take over immediately once the lock is released on the other side.

items.original: Resuming a conversation open in another app now shows a read-only transcript with a retry option while preserving your draft. (#43253)

title.zh-TW: 自動核准審查保留壓縮脈絡，遇新指令自動駁回失效授權
title.en: Automatic Approval Reviews Preserve Compaction Context and Reject Invalidated Authorizations

body.zh-TW: 面對需要反覆審核權限的操作流程，自動審查機制的判斷現在更加嚴謹周全。在對話歷程經歷壓縮（compaction，精簡長對話以節省記憶體的機制）後，自動核准審查機制能更完善地保留原本的授權脈絡，避免重要授權因紀錄濃縮而遺失。更重要的是，一旦使用者在後續給出了全新的指令或補充回答，只要先前的核准因此失效，審查機制就會果斷駁回該項核准，防止舊授權被錯誤套用到新情境。⟦類似於建築師審查工程變更單，即使過往會議紀錄經過摘要精簡，簽核依據依然完整留底；而只要業主中途變更了設計需求，先前簽核的舊工單就會立刻作廢重新評估。⟧
body.en: When dealing with workflows that require repeated permission reviews, automatic approval mechanisms are now more rigorous. Following conversation compaction, automatic approval reviews better preserve original authorization context, preventing critical authorizations from being lost due to history condensation. More importantly, once users provide fresh instructions or supplementary answers that invalidate earlier approvals, the review mechanism promptly rejects those approvals to prevent obsolete authorizations from being misapplied in new contexts. ⟦Similar to an architect reviewing engineering change orders, where approval records remain intact even after past meeting notes are summarized, but previously signed work orders are immediately invalidated for re-evaluation whenever the owner alters design requirements midway.⟧

items.original: Automatic approval reviews better preserve authorization context through compaction and reject approvals invalidated by new user instructions or answers. (#42844, #42852, #43442)

title.zh-TW: Astra 現身內建模型挑選器，未明確設定時成為預設選項
title.en: Astra now visible in the bundled model picker, becomes default when unconfigured

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟 Codex 準備寫程式時，如果沒有在設定中明確指定特定模型，現在會直接以 Astra 作為內建預設模型。過去 Astra 在內建的模型挑選器（供切換不同 AI 版本的選單）中可能無法正常看見，這次更新修復了顯示問題，讓它清楚出現在挑選清單供你點選；只要你未額外指定其他模型，它就會自動接手你的開發工作。⟦這就像走進專業工作間，出廠預設直接由全能技師接手派工，工具牆上的值班清單也正式掛出他的名牌，即使進門前沒特別指定師傅，也能直接享有標準服務。⟧這讓尚未配置偏好模型的日常操作能直接使用 Astra ，切換時也能在清單中快速找到。
body.en: When you open Codex to start coding, if no specific model is explicitly configured, Astra now serves directly as the bundled default model. Previously, Astra could fail to appear properly in the bundled model picker (a menu for switching between different AI versions); this update fixes the visibility issue, so it now shows up clearly in the selection list for you to pick; as long as you haven't specified another model, it automatically takes over your development work. ⟦It's like walking into a professional workshop where, by factory default, an all-around technician takes over your job assignment, and their name is now properly posted on the duty roster on the tool wall—even if you didn't specify a technician before walking in, you still get standard service right away.⟧ This lets everyday operations without a configured preferred model use Astra directly, and it can also be found quickly in the list when switching.

items.original: Fixed Astra’s visibility in the bundled model picker and made it the bundled default when no model is explicitly configured. (#42874)

title.zh-TW: Astra 調整非同步提問指引，僅在工作階段提供工具時發問
title.en: Astra's async-question guidance updated to ask only when the session provides the tool

body.zh-TW: 交給 Astra 處理複雜任務時，它在背景發問確認的行為現在更精準。這次更新調整了 Astra 的內建指引，明確限制它只有在目前工作階段確實具備提問工具時，才能向你發起非同步提問（在背景等候回覆、不卡住手邊工作的發問機制）。以前若環境未提供相應工具，模型可能仍會嘗試發送背景問題；現在有了這層條件約束，提問動作只會在支援的環境下觸發。⟦這如同野外巡邏隊員在遇到狀況時，會先檢查隨身裝備是否配有無線電對講機，只有在通訊器材完備時才向總部回傳發問，不會對著沒有訊號的空耳機呼叫。⟧如此一來，工作階段在缺乏提問模組時能維持穩定運行，不會被不合時宜的發問中斷。
body.en: When you hand Astra a complex task, its behavior of asking background confirmation questions is now more precise. This update adjusts Astra's built-in guidance, explicitly restricting it to initiate asynchronous questions to you (a mechanism that waits for a reply in the background without blocking your current work) only when the tool for questions is actually available in the current session. Previously, if the environment didn't provide the corresponding tool, the model could still attempt to send background questions; now with this condition in place, the questioning action only triggers in a supported environment. ⟦This is like a field patrol officer who, upon encountering a situation, first checks whether their gear includes a radio—only reporting back to headquarters with questions when the communication equipment is in place, rather than calling into a signal-less, empty headset.⟧ As a result, the session can keep running stably even when the questioning module is unavailable, without being interrupted by an ill-timed question.

items.original: Updated Astra’s guidance to use asynchronous questions only when the tool is available in the session. (#42878)

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 路由選單加入 GPT-6-Astra 模型
title.en: Amazon Bedrock Route Picker Adds GPT-6-Astra Model

body.zh-TW: 你在 Amazon Bedrock 雲端環境中調用 Codex 時，挑選模型有了新選項。⟦如同連鎖餐廳在特定分店的點餐機上，正式把最新招牌菜加入螢幕選單，走進指定門市的顧客直接按螢幕就能點選。⟧這項改動涵蓋 Mantle 路由，以及 Runtime 的 global 與 US 路由（route，雲端服務分配請求路徑的通道）。只要連線走這幾條途徑，你就能在模型挑選器（model picker，供手動切換不同 AI 版本的選單）中直接選取 GPT-6-Astra 模型。走 Mantle 或 Runtime 的 global／US 路由時，可在模型挑選器直接選 GPT-6-Astra。
body.en: When calling Codex in the Amazon Bedrock cloud environment, you now have a new option when selecting models. ⟦Much like a chain restaurant officially adding its latest signature dish to the screen menu on ordering kiosks at specific branches, allowing customers entering designated stores to select it directly on the screen.⟧ This change covers the Mantle route as well as Runtime's global and US routes. As long as your connection uses these paths, you can directly select the GPT-6-Astra model in the model picker. When routing through Mantle or Runtime global/US, you can directly choose GPT-6-Astra in the model picker.

items.original: Added GPT-6-Astra to the Amazon Bedrock model picker for Mantle and Runtime global/US routes. (#42805)

title.zh-TW: 修正 GPT-6-Astra 非同步提問指引，改用支援工具且認得純文字限制
title.en: Corrected GPT-6-Astra Guidance for Asynchronous Clarifications to Use Supported Tools and Recognize Text-Only Limits

body.zh-TW: 交給 GPT-6-Astra 的任務如果需求不明確，它在背景發問釐清的流程現在更穩定。這項改動修正了該模型提出非同步釐清問題（asynchronous clarification questions，不中斷手邊工作、在背景等候回覆的提問機制）時的內建指引。現在它會確實呼叫官方受支援的工具（supported tool，環境中明訂可用來向外部發問的功能模組），不再誤用不相容的管道。同時，它也能正確辨識該工具僅接受純文字內容，避免送出不支援的格式而引發錯誤。⟦宛如助理遇到交代不清的待辦事項時，會準確把疑問寫成便條紙投進專用留言箱，不再投錯信箱或塞進格式不符的包裹。⟧
body.en: When tasks assigned to GPT-6-Astra have unclear requirements, its process for asking clarifying questions in the background is now more reliable. This change corrects the model's built-in guidance when asking asynchronous clarification questions. It now properly calls officially supported tools instead of misusing incompatible channels. At the same time, it correctly recognizes that the tool accepts only plain text, avoiding errors caused by sending unsupported formats. ⟦Much like an assistant dealing with an unclearly explained task who accurately writes questions on a memo note and drops it into a dedicated message box, rather than dropping it into the wrong mailbox or stuffing in a parcel with an incompatible format.⟧

items.original: Corrected GPT-6-Astra’s guidance for asynchronous clarification questions to use the supported tool and recognize that it accepts text only. (#42809)

title.zh-TW: 新增 /skills reload 指令，免重啟工作階段即時重載技能
title.en: Added /skills reload Command to Instantly Reload Skills Without Restarting Session

body.zh-TW: 在終端機對話中途擴充技能或自訂指令，現在完全不必打斷當前思路。⟦宛如舞台劇在演出進行中，後台助理在側幕無聲換上新道具與曲目劇本，前台演員不必中斷表演，觀眾的觀賞體驗也絲毫不受干擾。⟧當你正在跟 AI 協同開發，臨時新增了一項技能檔案或自訂斜線指令，想立刻在對話中使用卻不想結束當前對話，這正是鍵入 `/skills reload` 的時刻。這項新增的子指令會在背景非同步重新載入所有偵測到的技能與斜線指令，既不用重新啟動工作階段（session），也不會暫停或鎖定你的終端機鍵盤輸入，讓你一邊繼續提問、一邊立即取用最新擴充。
body.en: Expanding skills or custom commands mid-conversation in the terminal no longer requires interrupting your flow. ⟦Just like backstage assistants quietly swapping in new props and scripts from the wings during an ongoing stage play, without the actors ever pausing their performance or the audience experiencing any disruption.⟧ When collaborating with AI and adding a new skill file or custom slash command that you want to use right away without ending the ongoing session, this is the exact moment to type `/skills reload`. This newly added subcommand asynchronously reloads all discovered skills and slash commands in the background without restarting the session or blocking terminal keyboard input, allowing you to keep asking questions while immediately utilizing the latest extensions.

items.original: Added a `/skills reload` subcommand to asynchronously reload discovered skills and slash commands without restarting the session or blocking user input.

title.zh-TW: 新增 /model 行內自動補齊與互動選單模糊搜尋列
title.en: Added Inline Autocomplete for /model and Fuzzy Search Bar in Interactive Picker

body.zh-TW: 切換對話所使用的運算模型時，現在不必再死記複雜的型號代碼。⟦好比走進大型圖書館的數位檢索機，只要在鍵盤敲入幾個關鍵字，螢幕即刻跳出推薦書單，挑選時更能依書名或索書號即時模糊比對，迅速定位想借閱的館藏。⟧當你需要針對複雜任務切換運算模型，這正是輸入 `/model` 的時刻。現在只要在終端機輸入 `/model` 時，輸入列就會即時彈出行內參數的自動補齊下拉選單；若進入互動式選單介面，上方還新增了即時模糊搜尋列，讓你能直接輸入模型名稱或型號 ID 快速過濾篩選，挑出最合適的目標。
body.en: When switching compute models during a conversation, you no longer need to memorize complex model IDs. ⟦Like searching a digital catalog in a large library, typing a few keywords on the keyboard immediately brings up recommended books, with real-time fuzzy matching across titles and call numbers to quickly locate desired items.⟧ When you need to switch compute models for complex tasks, this is the moment to enter `/model`. Typing `/model` in the terminal now instantly pops up an inline argument autocomplete dropdown; entering the interactive menu interface provides a live fuzzy search bar at the top, enabling you to filter quickly by model name or ID and pick the most suitable option.

items.original: Added an inline argument autocomplete dropdown when typing `/model` and a live fuzzy search bar inside the interactive `/model` picker to filter models by name or ID.

title.zh-TW: OAuth 權限不足時明確提示執行 /logout 與 /login 指令
title.en: Explicit Instructions to Run /logout and /login When OAuth Permissions Are Insufficient

body.zh-TW: 登入驗證遇到權限不足時，錯誤提示現在會給出明確的修復指引。以前當你的 OAuth token（授權令牌）缺少系統所需的存取權限範圍時，終端機只會拋出晦澀的授權失敗訊息，讓人不知該如何處理。現在系統改進了身分驗證錯誤提示，會直接在畫面中列出清晰的修復步驟，主動指引你依序執行 `/logout` 登出與 `/login` 重新登入指令以更新權限。⟦這如同門禁通行證上的感應權限不足時，驗證閘門不再只閃爍冰冷的紅燈，而是清楚指示你前往服務櫃台辦理註銷並重新感應登錄。⟧
body.en: Error messages now provide explicit remediation instructions when encountering insufficient permissions during authentication. Previously, when an OAuth token lacked required access scopes, the terminal merely threw an obscure authorization failure message, leaving users unsure how to resolve it. Authentication error prompts have now been improved to display clear recovery steps directly on screen, actively guiding you to run `/logout` and `/login` sequentially to refresh permissions. ⟦Like an access gate that no longer just flashes a cold red light when a security badge lacks permissions, but clearly instructs you to visit the service desk to revoke and re-authenticate.⟧

items.original: Improved authentication error messages when OAuth tokens lack required scopes by including explicit instructions to run `/logout` and `/login`.

title.zh-TW: 修復切換至 Gemini 思考模型與聯網搜尋摘要的解析異常
title.en: Fixed Parsing Errors When Switching to Gemini Thinking Models and Web Search Summaries

body.zh-TW: 無論中途切換至具備推理能力的 Gemini 思考模型，或是執行聯網搜尋，運作流程現在更加順暢。以前若前幾輪對話是由非 Gemini 模型所產生，中途切換為 Gemini 思考模型時，系統會因為找不到前序對話的 `thought_signature`（思考簽章）而跳出格式驗證錯誤。此外，使用 `search_web` 聯網搜尋工具時，若負責產出摘要的模型在開頭吐出了思考過程片段，也會導致搜尋以 `"no summary returned from GenerateContent"` 錯誤失敗。這兩項思考模型解析問題現在都已經修好，模型切換與搜尋摘要皆能如常運作。⟦有如不同樂團的指揮家在中途接力交接樂譜，就算前段演奏並未標註特定的呼吸記號，接棒的指揮也能順暢接續演奏，不再因為記譜格式不同而中斷整場音樂會。⟧
body.en: Workflows now run much smoother whether switching mid-conversation to Gemini thinking models equipped with reasoning capabilities or executing web searches. Previously, when prior conversation turns were generated by non-Gemini models, switching mid-session to a Gemini thinking model would fail with format validation errors due to missing `thought_signature` from previous turns. In addition, when using the `search_web` tool, if the summarization model emitted leading thought parts, the search would fail with a `"no summary returned from GenerateContent"` error. Both parsing issues with thinking models have now been fixed, allowing model switching and search summaries to function as expected. ⟦Like guest conductors handing off sheet music mid-performance, the incoming conductor continues smoothly even if earlier passages lacked specific breathing marks, preventing the concert from halting over notation differences.⟧

items.original:
Fixed mid-conversation model switching to Gemini thinking models failing with `thought_signature` validation errors when prior turns were generated by non-Gemini models.
Fixed web search (`search_web`) failing with `"no summary returned from GenerateContent"` when the summarization model emits leading thought parts.

title.zh-TW: 工具呼叫格式錯誤時代理迴圈會回傳錯誤並自我修正
title.en: Agent Loop Returns Errors and Self-Corrects on Tool Call Validation Failures

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 自動調用工具時，若參數格式不合規，流程不再直接斷線罷工。以前當工具呼叫未通過結構驗證（schema validation）時，對話輪次會過早以 `NO_TOOL_CALL` 錯誤直接終止，導致工作被迫中斷。現在這個問題已經修好，代理迴圈會將驗證錯誤訊息回傳給 AI，讓模型能即時理解錯誤並自動修正參數重新呼叫。
body.en: When letting AI invoke tools automatically, invalid argument formats no longer abruptly terminate the workflow. Previously, when a tool call failed schema validation, the conversation turn would terminate prematurely with a `NO_TOOL_CALL` error, forcing work to halt. This issue has now been resolved: the agent loop returns the validation error message to the AI, allowing the model to promptly understand the error, correct its arguments, and retry the call.

items.original: Fixed agent turns terminating prematurely with `NO_TOOL_CALL` when a tool call fails schema validation, allowing the agent loop to return the validation error and self-correct.

title.zh-TW: 修復 MCP 工具定義原地修改與 hooks.json 遭預算截斷問題
title.en: Fixed In-Place MCP Tool Definition Mutation and hooks.json Token Budget Truncation

body.zh-TW: 自訂擴充設定與外部工具整合，現在運作更加穩定可靠。⟦彷彿工廠流水線在擴充新模具時，直接複製了一份專屬加工樣板，既不會在共用設計圖上塗改破壞原有尺寸標準，也不會在控制台進行總長度修剪時遺漏了預先掛載的感應開關。⟧以前系統在為 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）擴充工具結構時，會直接在記憶體中就地修改工具定義，導致後續觸發嚴格參數驗證失敗。同時，當自訂內容啟動 token（AI 處理文字的計量單位）預算截斷機制時，原本在 `hooks.json` 設定的掛鉤規則還會無預警被整份丟棄。這兩項設定遺失與參數驗證問題現在都已修好。
body.en: Custom extension configurations and external tool integrations now operate with greater stability and reliability. ⟦Like a factory assembly line duplicating a dedicated processing template when expanding with new molds, neither defacing original dimension standards on shared blueprints nor dropping pre-mounted sensor switches during total length trimming on the console.⟧ Previously, when the system augmented tool schemas for MCP (Model Context Protocol), it mutated tool definitions in place in memory, triggering subsequent strict argument validation failures. Meanwhile, when customization token budget truncation was activated, hook rules configured in `hooks.json` were silently dropped without warning. Both configuration loss and parameter validation issues have now been resolved.

items.original:
Fixed MCP tool schema augmentation mutating tool definitions in place, preventing strict argument validation failures.
Fixed `hooks.json` configurations being silently dropped when customization token budget truncation is active.

title.zh-TW: 修復自訂子代理 exclude 技能過濾遺失與終止狀態被誤重設問題
title.en: Fixed Custom Subagent exclude Skill Filter Loss and Accidental Reset of Termination Status

body.zh-TW: 指派專門分工的自訂子代理（subagent，負責特定分工的輔助 AI）協同工作時，權限過濾與狀態追蹤更加精確。以前當系統在執行階段套用技能過濾時，自訂子代理會遺失原本設定的 `exclude` 技能排除清單。同時，在發布訂閱機制的批次合併更新下，已被終止的子代理也容易因晚到的步驟更新而被錯誤重設為活躍狀態。這兩項技能過濾與狀態追蹤問題現在都已經修好。⟦恰如專案主管指派外包團隊執行特定任務，既確保外包團隊不會擅自碰觸被禁止的機密工具，也在任務結案並撤銷權限後，不會因晚到的進度回報而誤將該小組重新標示為作業中。⟧
body.en: Permission filtering and status tracking are now more precise when delegating tasks to specialized custom subagents. Previously, when runtime skill filtering was applied, custom subagents would lose their configured `exclude` skill filter lists. Additionally, under pubsub batch coalescing updates, killed subagents could be mistakenly reset to active status by late step updates. Both skill filtering and status tracking issues have now been fixed. ⟦Like a project manager assigning specific tasks to an outsourced team, ensuring they cannot touch restricted confidential tools, and preventing the team from being mistakenly marked active by delayed progress reports after the task is closed and permissions are revoked.⟧

items.original:
Fixed custom subagents losing configured `exclude` skill filters when runtime skill filtering is applied.
Fixed subagent status and termination tracking under pubsub batch coalescing so killed subagents are not reset to active by late step updates.

title.zh-TW: 修復重啟後對話與背景常駐工作無法自動復原及日誌遺漏問題
title.en: Fixed Conversation and Daemon Background Task Auto-Resume Failures and Omitted Logs After Restart

body.zh-TW: 終端機重新啟動後的對話復原與除錯記錄，現在更加完整可靠。以前當對話中仍有正在進行的發言輪次、或是背景有正在執行的 daemon（背景常駐程式）工作時，重新啟動後往往無法順利自動恢復對話。同時，終端機中發生的 `ERROR` 錯誤步驟（例如工具執行失敗或逾時），過去也常在 `transcript.jsonl` 對話記錄檔中被意外漏掉。這兩項工作階段自動復原與日誌記錄問題現在都已經修好。⟦宛若航行記錄器在飛行中忠實記錄每一筆警報日誌，即使儀表系統在中途重新開機，所有正在運作的背景巡航裝置也能在重啟後立即接續運轉。⟧
body.en: Conversation recovery and debug logging following terminal restarts are now more complete and dependable. Previously, when a conversation had active turns or daemon background tasks running, auto-resuming the session smoothly after a restart often failed. Furthermore, terminal `ERROR` steps (such as failed tool executions or timeouts) were frequently omitted from `transcript.jsonl` conversation logs. Both session auto-recovery and logging issues have now been resolved. ⟦Like a flight recorder faithfully logging every alarm during flight, all operational background cruising systems can immediately resume running after a reboot, even if instrument systems restart mid-air.⟧

items.original:
Fixed conversations with active turns or running daemon background tasks failing to auto-resume after a restart.
Fixed terminal `ERROR` steps (such as failed tool executions or timeouts) being omitted from `transcript.jsonl` conversation logs.

title.zh-TW: SSH 連線於 Apple_Terminal 停用不支援的超連結跳脫序列
title.en: Disabled Unsupported Hyperlink Escape Sequences in Apple_Terminal Over SSH Connections

body.zh-TW: 透過 SSH 遠端連線在 macOS 原生終端機操作時，畫面文字不再出現多餘的亂碼符號。以前使用 `Apple_Terminal` 建立 SSH 連線時，由於終端機不支援特定的超連結格式，畫面上會直接印出未解析的 OSC 8 原始跳脫序列（escape sequences）。現在系統已主動停用不支援的超連結序列，這個顯示問題已經修好，遠端文字呈現恢復乾淨整潔。
body.en: Terminal text no longer displays stray garbled characters when operating over SSH connections in native macOS terminals. Previously, when establishing SSH connections using `Apple_Terminal`, unsupported hyperlink formats caused raw, unparsed OSC 8 escape sequences to print directly to the screen. The system now proactively disables unsupported hyperlink sequences, resolving this display glitch and restoring clean remote text rendering.

items.original: Fixed raw OSC 8 escape sequences rendering in `Apple_Terminal` over SSH connections by disabling unsupported hyperlink sequences.

title.zh-TW: 新增 /copy btw 複製旁支回答全文，打指令附帶參數幽靈提示
title.en: Add /copy btw to copy full text of side-question responses, with argument ghost hints when typing commands

body.zh-TW: 一邊等待 AI 處理主要工作，一邊透過 `/btw` 提出旁支問題，取用解答文字現在更加俐落。⟦這好比在研討會聽講時，你在桌角備忘便條隨手記下專家的延伸解答；即使便條紙正巧被厚重講義遮住或摺疊收攏，專屬助理也能替你將整張便條的文字原樣複印到筆記夾中。⟧當你交代助理撰寫長篇企劃，趁空檔用 `/btw` 查詢專有名詞，讀完後想把整段答覆貼進工作報告，這正是輸入 `/copy btw` 的時刻。這項新增的斜線子指令，能將當前進行中的 `/btw` 旁支回答全文直接複製至剪貼簿，就算回覆卡片已經收合或被捲動移出可見畫面，也完全不影響複製。此外，當你在終端機鍵入 `/copy` 時，指令輸入列還會顯示參數的幽靈提示（輸入指令時以淡色顯示的待填參數建議），提醒你能接續輸入哪些可用選項。
body.en: While waiting for AI to handle primary tasks, asking side questions via `/btw` and retrieving the answer text is now much smoother. ⟦This is like attending a conference lecture and jotting down an expert's elaboration on a sticky note at the corner of your desk; even if the note happens to be covered by heavy handouts or folded away, your dedicated assistant can still copy the exact text from the entire note into your binder for you.⟧ When you ask an assistant to draft a long-form proposal and use `/btw` during downtime to look up technical terms, and then want to paste the full answer into your report after reading, this is the exact moment to type `/copy btw`. This newly added slash subcommand copies the full text of the active `/btw` side-question response directly to your clipboard, even if the response card is collapsed or scrolled out of view. In addition, when you type `/copy` in the terminal, the command input bar displays argument ghost hints (faded suggestions for parameters to fill in while typing commands) to remind you of available options you can enter next.

items.original: Added the `/copy btw` slash subcommand to copy the full text of the active `/btw` side-question response to the clipboard even when the response card is collapsed or scrolled, along with argument ghost hints when typing `/copy`.

title.zh-TW: 工具選用約束轉為原生後端設定，提升呼叫忠實度
title.en: Translate tool-choice constraints into native backend configurations to improve calling fidelity

body.zh-TW: 指揮 AI 配合特定流程呼叫工具時，模型遵循呼叫限制的表現現在更加精準可靠。以前在每次請求中指定工具選用約束，例如限制必須呼叫任意工具的 `any`、強制調用工具的 `required`，或是指定特定具名函式，若未深入底層，執行時偶爾仍可能偏離指示。現在系統會將每筆請求的工具選用約束，直接轉換為後端原生的函式呼叫設定（由模型服務底層介面直接控管工具挑選的機制），確保工具呼叫的保真度徹底落實。⟦恰似精密物流中心的分揀輸送帶，當包裹貼上「必須檢驗」或指定特定通道的標籤時，系統直接將分流指令寫入輸送帶底層的感應電路，包裹自然順著軌道精準送達，不再有任何錯漏。⟧
body.en: When directing AI to call tools for specific workflows, the model's adherence to calling restrictions is now more precise and reliable. Previously, when specifying per-request tool-choice constraints—such as `any` requiring calling any tool, `required` enforcing tool invocation, or specifying named functions—executions could still occasionally deviate from instructions if not integrated into the underlying layer. Now, the system directly translates per-request tool-choice constraints into native backend function-calling configurations (a mechanism where the model service's underlying interface directly manages tool selection), ensuring complete fidelity in tool calling. ⟦Just like a sorting conveyor belt in a precision logistics center, when a package is labeled 'must inspect' or assigned a specific lane, the system writes routing instructions directly into the conveyor's underlying sensor circuits, allowing packages to arrive precisely along the track without errors.⟧

items.original: Improved tool-calling fidelity by translating per-request tool-choice constraints (`any`, `required`, and named functions) into native backend function-calling configurations.

title.zh-TW: /hooks 與檢查工具納入已啟用外掛隨附的掛鉤設定
title.en: Include hook configurations bundled inside enabled plugins in /hooks and inspection utilities

body.zh-TW: 檢查自動化流程的掛鉤設定時，外掛隨附的規則不再無端隱形。以前在終端機執行 `/hooks` 指令或使用掛鉤檢查工具列出使用中的 `hooks.json` 設定時，系統會漏掉已啟用外掛套件裡自帶的 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），導致你難以確認外掛功能是否如期攔截；這個遺漏問題現在已經修好，清單會如實列出已啟用外掛隨附的所有掛鉤設定。
body.en: When inspecting hook configurations in automated workflows, rules bundled with plugins no longer invisibly disappear. Previously, when running the `/hooks` command in the terminal or using hook inspection utilities to list active `hooks.json` configurations, the system omitted hooks bundled inside enabled plugin packages (small programs triggered when specific events occur), making it difficult to verify whether plugin features were intercepting as expected. This omission issue is now fixed, and listings faithfully include all hook configurations bundled with enabled plugins.

items.original: Fixed the `/hooks` command and hook inspection utilities omitting hooks bundled inside enabled plugins when listing active `hooks.json` configurations.

title.zh-TW: 自訂子代理繼承父代理 MCP 伺服器，並正確解析相對設定路徑
title.en: Custom subagents inherit parent MCP servers and correctly resolve relative configuration paths

body.zh-TW: 配置專門分工的自訂子代理時，工具連線與檔案路徑的兩項問題已獲修正。以前在建立自訂子代理時就算指定了 `enable_mcp_tools: true`，子代理也只會收到一份空的伺服器清單，無法順利繼承父代理原先設定妥當的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器；同時，宣告式子代理設定若使用 `relative_path_to_config` 指定相對設定檔路徑，系統也無法以父代理所在的目錄為基準完成解析。這兩項路徑與設定繼承問題現在都已經修好，子代理會確實繼承父代理的外部工具伺服器，相對路徑也能順利對齊。
body.en: When configuring custom subagents for specialized division of labor, two issues with tool connections and file paths have been fixed. Previously, even if `enable_mcp_tools: true` was specified when creating a custom subagent, the subagent only received an empty server list and failed to inherit the configured MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol allowing AI to connect to external tools) servers from the parent agent. At the same time, if a declarative subagent configuration specified a relative configuration file path using `relative_path_to_config`, the system failed to resolve it against the parent agent's directory. Both path and configuration inheritance issues are now fixed, ensuring subagents properly inherit the parent agent's external tool servers and relative paths align smoothly.

items.original: Fixed custom subagents created with `enable_mcp_tools: true` receiving an empty MCP server list instead of inheriting the parent agent's configured MCP servers, and fixed declarative subagent configurations failing to resolve relative config file paths (`relative_path_to_config`) against the parent agent's directory.

title.zh-TW: 主動回饋提示不再過早跳出，排除初期對話與暫態錯誤干擾
title.en: Proactive feedback prompts no longer trigger prematurely, eliminating early-session and transient-error disruptions

body.zh-TW: 在終端機展開新對話或使用工具時，評分詢問不再無端跳出打擾節奏。以前只要工作階段剛開始的前幾輪對話、或者工具遇到短暫發生但隨後已順利復原的暫態錯誤，系統的主動回饋提示就會過早觸發，在任務尚未明朗時突然向你索取意見；這個過早觸發的問題現在已經修好，不會再在對話初期或暫態錯誤復原時過早彈出提示打斷思路。
body.en: When starting a new conversation in the terminal or using tools, feedback rating prompts no longer pop up unexpectedly to disrupt your flow. Previously, during the first few turns of a session or when tools encountered transient errors that quickly recovered, proactive feedback prompts triggered prematurely, soliciting feedback before tasks were clear. This premature triggering issue is now fixed, preventing pop-up prompts from interrupting your train of thought during early conversations or recovered transient errors.

items.original: Fixed proactive feedback prompts triggering prematurely during the first few turns of a session or on transient, recovered tool errors.

title.zh-TW: `unsandboxed` 權限棄用警告升級，列出檔案路徑、五條違規規則與 `command` 遷移步驟
title.en: Upgraded Deprecation Warning for `unsandboxed` Permissions Lists File Paths, Five Offending Rules, and `command` Migration Steps

body.zh-TW: 管理專案安全防護有了更清楚的指引。舊版廢棄規則的啟動警告現在能精準指出問題所在。⟦宛如大樓消防安檢人員巡檢後開立改善通知單，不僅逐一標出違規的樓層門牌，更明確列出最多五處不合規的排煙閥位置，並附上標準更換步驟。⟧以前若在命令列全域、共用或個別專案設定檔中殘留了舊版的 `unsandboxed` 權限規則，啟動警告往往讓人找不著頭緒。現在啟動提示全面改善，會逐一列出每個受影響的設定檔完整路徑，直接列出最多五條違規規則，並附上逐步遷移指引，帶領你將它們改寫為新版的 `command` 規則，維護工作一目了然。
body.en: Managing project security protections is now guided by clearer instructions. Startup warnings for deprecated legacy rules now pinpoint exactly where the issues lie. ⟦Much like a building fire safety inspector issuing a correction notice that not only marks the offending floor room numbers one by one, but also specifically lists up to five non-compliant smoke damper locations and attaches standard replacement steps.⟧ In the past, leaving legacy `unsandboxed` permission rules in CLI global, shared, or individual project configuration files often resulted in confusing startup warnings. Now, the startup warning has been thoroughly improved to list the full path of each affected configuration file, explicitly display up to five offending rules, and provide step-by-step migration instructions to guide you through rewriting them into new `command` rules, making maintenance crystal clear.

items.original: Improved the startup warning for deprecated `unsandboxed` permission rules across CLI, shared, and project configuration files to list each affected file path, up to five offending rules, and step-by-step instructions for migrating them to `command` rules.

title.zh-TW: `/resume` 啟動反應加速，冷快取與過期摘要快速載入長篇對話
title.en: `/resume` Startup Responsiveness Accelerated, Fast Loading for Long Conversations with Cold Caches and Stale Summaries

body.zh-TW: 接續先前討論過的大型長篇任務，恢復對話的載入反應現在敏捷許多。⟦好似老航海船長翻開厚實的航行日誌，就算前段航程的彙整摘要尚未預先抄錄、或是前次留下的備忘筆記早已過期，也能立刻翻至指定頁面接續記錄，不再被卡在漫長的翻查等待中。⟧以前在終端機輸入 `/resume` 指令嘗試開啟對話紀錄特別龐大的歷史時，只要摘要快取（把對話內容預先暫存起來以加速讀取的機制）處於尚未預熱的冷啟動狀態、或者快取內容已經過期，啟動過程往往會出現明顯的停頓延遲。現在這項啟動反應速度已獲得改善，即使面對快取尚未就緒或內容過期的長篇歷史紀錄，也能迅速完成載入並恢復對話。
body.en: Resuming large, extended tasks from previous discussions is now significantly more responsive. ⟦Like an experienced sea captain opening a thick logbook who can immediately turn to the target page and continue recording without getting stuck in a long search, even if the summary of the previous voyage has not been prepared yet or the previous memo notes have long expired.⟧ Previously, when running the `/resume` command in the terminal to open an exceptionally large conversation history, noticeable delays would occur whenever the summary cache (a mechanism that temporarily stores conversation content in advance to speed up reading) was cold or stale. This startup responsiveness has now been improved, allowing the system to quickly complete loading and resume conversations even with unready or expired caches over long conversation histories.

items.original: Improved `/resume` startup responsiveness when opening a large conversation history with a cold or stale summary cache.

title.zh-TW: 外掛隨附 MCP 伺服器自動套用命名空間，徹底防範重名衝突
title.en: Plugin-Bundled MCP Servers Automatically Namespaced to Prevent Name Collisions

body.zh-TW: 為終端機擴充各式外部工具，外掛隨附的伺服器重名衝突現在迎刃而解。當你使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）時，不同外掛套件隨附的伺服器，過去若恰好取了相同的名稱，彼此之間、或是與你在 `mcp_config.json` 中自訂的伺服器便會發生衝突與覆蓋。這種命名撞車會導致其中一方無法正常運作。現在系統會自動替外掛隨附的伺服器加上命名空間，統一改以 `<plugin>_<server>` 的格式獨立註冊，徹底解決重名互相覆蓋的問題。⟦恰如大型聯合辦公室替各進駐團隊編發專屬分機號碼，在內部總機名稱前自動加上團隊代號，就算不同團隊都恰巧指派了一位「總務」，各分機撥通時也絕不互相佔線或搶撥。⟧
body.en: When extending the terminal with various external tools, name collisions among plugin-bundled servers are now completely resolved. When using MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools), bundled servers across different plugins that happened to share the same name previously collided with each other or overwrote custom servers in your `mcp_config.json`. Such naming clashes would prevent one of the servers from working properly. The system now automatically namespaces plugin-bundled servers, registering them independently in the `<plugin>_<server>` format to eliminate overlapping naming conflicts. ⟦Just like a large coworking space assigning dedicated extension numbers to each resident team by prefixing team codes to internal directory names, ensuring that even if multiple teams each appoint a "general affairs" lead, calls to different extensions never interfere with or intercept each other.⟧

items.original: Fixed MCP servers bundled inside plugins colliding with each other or with user-configured servers in `mcp_config.json` when they shared the same server name by automatically namespacing plugin MCP servers as `<plugin>_<server>`.

title.zh-TW: 開啟或切換對話修復背景協程洩漏，顯著降低記憶體佔用
title.en: Opening or Switching Conversations Fixes Background Goroutine Leak, Significantly Reducing Memory Usage

body.zh-TW: 頻繁開啟歷史對話或在任務間切換，終端機不再悄悄囤積過多電腦記憶體。⟦彷彿房務人員走進客房整理床單後，卻忘記關閉浴室抽風機與走廊照明，讓馬達在無人使用的空房中持續空轉耗電，如今退房流程落實了隨手關閉機制，房間巡檢完畢便即刻切斷閒置電器。⟧以前只要在命令列開啟或掃描對話紀錄，背景負責清理步驟快取（用來暫存各執行步驟紀錄的內部機制）的背景協程常會殘留下來，並在整個工作階段中持續運行，造成不必要的記憶體流失。這個記憶體流失問題現在已經修好，執行 `/resume` 重新載入對話或在不同對話間頻繁切換後，系統記憶體佔用顯著減少，長久運作依然維持輕快。
body.en: When frequently opening conversation histories or switching between tasks, the terminal no longer silently accumulates excessive system memory. ⟦Much like housekeeping staff making beds in a guest room but forgetting to turn off the bathroom exhaust fan and hallway lights, leaving motors idling and consuming electricity in an empty room, whereas the check-out process now enforces a shutdown protocol to immediately cut power to idle appliances after room inspection.⟧ Previously, whenever conversation histories were opened or scanned from the command line, background goroutines responsible for evicting step cache (an internal mechanism for temporarily caching execution step records) often lingered and ran throughout the rest of the session, causing unnecessary memory leaks. This memory leak has now been fixed, significantly reducing system memory usage after running `/resume` or switching between conversations, keeping long-running sessions nimble and responsive.

items.original: Fixed a memory leak where opening or scanning conversations left background step-cache eviction goroutines running for the rest of the session, significantly reducing memory usage after opening `/resume` or switching conversations.

title.zh-TW: `view_file` 拒絕非 UTF-8 二進位檔與 100 MB 超大檔，防止上下文塞爆
title.en: `view_file` Rejects Non-UTF-8 Binary Files and 100 MB Oversized Files to Prevent Context Overflow

body.zh-TW: 把檔案交給 AI 閱讀時，工具現在能主動擋下會塞爆上下文視窗的非預期輸入。以前使用 `view_file` 工具查看檔案時，若遇上非 UTF-8 編碼的二進位檔案，往往會硬當成純文字解析；甚至在碰上體積大於 100 MB 的超大檔案時，也會直接嘗試塞進模型的上下文視窗（模型在單一輪對話中所能讀取與容納的文字容量上限）。這種過度載入常導致對話中斷或發生錯誤。現在這項缺陷已經修好，面對不支援的二進位格式與超大檔案，工具會在讀取前直接予以拒絕並回傳明確錯誤，避免塞爆模型上下文視窗。⟦好比自動文件掃描機的進紙托盤，遇到未支援的透明塑膠板、或是厚度超過一百頁的厚重硬皮書時，會在入紙口主動退件並亮起清楚的錯誤警示，絕不硬塞進滾輪以防卡紙扯壞內部機件。⟧
body.en: When handing files over for AI reading, the tool now actively intercepts unexpected inputs that would overflow the context window. Previously, when using `view_file` to inspect files, non-UTF-8 encoded binary files were often forcibly parsed as plain text, and files larger than 100 MB were directly loaded into the model's context window (the upper limit of text capacity that the model can ingest and hold in a single turn). Such overloading frequently led to conversation aborts or errors. This defect is now fixed; unsupported binary formats and oversized files are directly rejected with a clear error before loading, preventing context window overflows. ⟦Much like an automatic document scanner tray that actively rejects unsupported transparent plastic sheets or bulky hardcover books exceeding one hundred pages at the feeder with a clear error warning, never forcing them into the rollers to prevent paper jams and internal mechanical damage.⟧

items.original: Fixed `view_file` attempting to parse non-UTF-8 binary files as text or loading files larger than 100 MB into the model context; unsupported binary formats and oversized files are now rejected with a clear error before overflowing the context window.

title.zh-TW: Gemini API 工作階段保留前輪思考區塊，並正確傳遞思考簽章
title.en: Gemini API Sessions Retain Thinking Blocks from Prior Turns and Correctly Propagate Thought Signatures

body.zh-TW: 透過金鑰與模型展開多輪深度交談，上一輪的思考脈絡現在能完好延續。⟦恰似數學競賽選手在多輪解題時保留每一步草稿演算，並在每段推導末端加蓋防偽個人戳記，交卷時所有先前的思考手稿與印鑑都能完整夾帶遞交，不會在進入下一題時把前一題的推論過程整張撕毀。⟧以前透過 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 啟動 Gemini API 工作階段時，每當使用者送出後續的新訊息，系統往往會遺失先前對話輪次中的模型思考區塊。同時，文字段落與思考段落上的思考簽章（用來驗證推論過程完整性與身分的數位記號）也無法正常傳遞。這兩項缺陷現在皆已修正，模型的思考紀錄與簽章能在多輪對話中順暢保留並正確傳播。
body.en: When engaging in multi-turn in-depth conversations with models via API keys, the thinking context from prior turns is now cleanly preserved. ⟦Just like a math competition contestant preserving draft calculations for every step across multiple problem-solving rounds and stamping an anti-counterfeit personal seal at the end of each derivation, so that all prior thought manuscripts and seals are submitted together without tearing up earlier reasoning when moving to the next question.⟧ Previously, when launching Gemini API sessions via `GEMINI_API_KEY`, sending subsequent user messages often caused the system to drop model thinking blocks from previous conversation turns. Additionally, thought signatures (digital markers used to verify the integrity and identity of reasoning processes) on text and thought parts failed to propagate properly. Both defects have now been fixed, allowing model thinking records and signatures to be smoothly retained and correctly propagated across multiple conversation turns.

items.original: Fixed Gemini API (`GEMINI_API_KEY`) sessions dropping model thinking blocks from prior turns on subsequent user messages and failing to propagate thought signatures on text and thought parts.

title.zh-TW: 產出物審查修復父路徑比對，對話分支與快照排除系統內部目錄
title.en: Artifact Review Fixes Parent Path Matching; Conversation Forks and Snapshots Exclude Internal System Directories

body.zh-TW: 審查程式產出物或建立對話分支，專案內部目錄的管理現在更加乾淨俐落。以前若在 `.gemini/` 之上的父目錄路徑中包含 `scratch` 等被忽略的路徑名稱，產出物審查（檢視程式碼生成成果的檢查面板）常會意外失效而無法觸發。此外，在執行對話分支或快照復原時，過去常會多餘複製內部專用的 `.system_generated/subagents` 與 `.system_generated/worktrees` 資料夾，且在刪除對話時也未清理子代理人的後設資料。如今這些管理問題均已修復，分支與復原不再夾帶內部目錄，刪除對話時也會同步清除子代理人紀錄。⟦如同建築事務所封存設計專案時妥善區隔公開成果與內部暫存，分流衍生新圖紙時主動排除草稿夾裡的臨時施工模型與分身圖層，專案結案銷毀時也同步清空各協力小組的派工備忘錄。⟧
body.en: When reviewing code artifacts or branching conversations, internal project directory management is now much cleaner. Previously, if a parent directory path above `.gemini/` contained skipped path names such as `scratch`, artifact review (an inspection panel for reviewing generated code outputs) often failed to trigger. In addition, when executing conversation forks or snapshot reverts, internal `.system_generated/subagents` and `.system_generated/worktrees` directories were unnecessarily copied, and deleting conversations failed to clean up subagent metadata. These management issues have now been resolved: forks and reverts no longer include internal directories, and deleting a conversation cleanly purges subagent records. ⟦Like an architecture firm archiving design projects by properly separating public deliverables from internal temp files, actively excluding temporary construction models and duplicate draft layers when branching new blueprints, and clearing assignment memos across partner teams when closing and destroying a project.⟧

items.original: Fixed artifact review failing to trigger when a directory name above `.gemini/` matched a skipped path component such as `scratch`, prevented conversation forks and snapshot reverts from copying internal `.system_generated/subagents` and `.system_generated/worktrees` directories, and cleaned up subagent metadata records when deleting a conversation.

title.zh-TW: 修復已刪除對話在背景重新連線時誤建為空白 `SQLite` 資料庫
title.en: Fixes Deleted Conversations Recreated as Empty `SQLite` Databases on Background Reconnection

body.zh-TW: 手動清空不需要的舊對話紀錄，已經被刪除的歷史檔案絕不再死灰復燃。⟦有如銀行客戶前往櫃台辦理結清銷戶後，即使後台批次排程稍後才再次連線清查餘額，系統也絕不會因為收到查詢請求，就莫名在金庫中自動重新立起一個連帳號欄位都沒有的空白保險箱。⟧以前在使用者刪除對話紀錄之後，若有背景查詢作業嘗試重新連線，往往會在底層硬生生重新建立起一筆空白且缺乏資料結構的 `SQLite` 資料庫檔案。這些幽靈檔案不僅徒增混亂，也無法正常讀取。這個幽靈重建問題現在已經徹底修復，背景查詢重新連線時不會再擅自生成空白資料庫，刪除對話確實清爽乾淨。
body.en: When manually clearing unwanted conversation histories, deleted history files will never resurface. ⟦Like a bank customer closing an account at the counter, where even if backend batch schedules reconnect later to check balances, the system never automatically erects an empty safe in the vault lacking even account fields just because an inquiry request was received.⟧ Previously, after a user deleted conversation histories, any background queries attempting to reconnect would recreate empty, schema-less `SQLite` database files underneath. These ghost files added clutter and could not be read properly. This ghost recreation bug has now been completely resolved; background queries reconnecting after deletion no longer generate empty databases, keeping conversation deletions truly clean.

items.original: Fixed deleted conversations being recreated as empty, schema-less SQLite database files when background queries reconnected after deletion.

title.zh-TW: 無工作區對話維持獨立隔離，不再意外繼承其他工作階段自訂路徑
title.en: Workspaceless Conversations Maintain Strict Isolation, No Longer Inheriting Custom Paths from Other Sessions

body.zh-TW: 不在任何專案目錄下隨手開啟終端機，獨立交談環境現在具備完善的隔離邊界。以前在未指定工作區資料夾的狀態下啟動新對話，該工作階段往往會意外繼承其他正在運行的開啟工作階段中的專案路徑與自訂設定。這種跨工作階段的設定滲漏，容易導致臨時對話誤讀了無關專案的客製化規則或檔案目錄。這個隔離缺陷現在已經修好，未指定工作區的對話會維持純粹獨立，不再擅自套用其他工作階段的環境路徑與自訂設定。⟦這好比走進共享空間租用一張臨時空桌，桌面上乾淨清空，既不會莫名翻出隔壁專案工作室遺留的門禁磁卡與私人物料，也不會意外套用其他租客專屬的自訂燈光偏好。⟧
body.en: When launching the terminal outside of any project directory, standalone conversation environments now maintain proper isolation boundaries. Previously, when starting a new conversation without a workspace folder, the session often inadvertently inherited project paths and customizations from other open sessions running concurrently. This cross-session leak caused ad-hoc conversations to mistakenly read irrelevant project rules or file directories. This isolation defect has now been fixed: conversations launched without a workspace folder remain purely standalone, no longer inheriting environment paths and custom settings from other sessions. ⟦Much like renting a temporary hot desk in a shared workspace with a clean, clear surface, where you neither uncover access keycards and personal materials left behind by adjacent project studios nor inadvertently adopt another tenant's custom lighting preferences.⟧

items.original: Fixed conversations launched without a workspace folder inheriting workspace paths and customizations from other open sessions.

title.zh-TW: 週額度用完警示校準推算邏輯，短暫衝刺不再引發誤報
title.en: Weekly quota exhaustion warnings calibrate projection logic, preventing false alarms from brief usage bursts

body.zh-TW: 密集使用 AI 時，週額度用完警示不再因短時間衝刺就誤報。⟦這好比行車電腦預估剩餘續航，不能只因剛踩了幾秒重油門，就驚呼整桶油在半小時內見底。⟧過去只拿最近 30～60 分鐘的消耗速度外推整個 7 天週期，密集工作階段常引發假警報（例如本週用了 53.7%、還有 3 天 1 小時重置，卻警告「13 小時後用完」）。現在 `assess_weekly_quota()` 同時檢查兩種速度：短窗速度若預測 1 小時內用完仍會立刻示警；其餘情況須整週平均速度預測用完時間提前至少 20%（`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`）才警示。介面改為顯示整週平均預測的時間，不再出現「8h55m 後用完」卻與旁邊 5 小時工作階段額度矛盾的狀況；5 小時工作階段額度警示規則維持不變。
body.en: During intensive AI use, weekly quota exhaustion warnings no longer trigger false alarms from short bursts of activity. ⟦This is like a trip computer estimating remaining range—it shouldn't panic that the entire tank will run dry in half an hour just because you stepped on the gas for a few seconds.⟧ Previously, it extrapolated only the burn rate from the last 30–60 minutes across the entire 7-day cycle, so intensive sessions often triggered false alarms (such as using 53.7% this week with 3 days and 1 hour until reset, yet warning "runs out in 13 hours"). Now, `assess_weekly_quota()` checks both rates: if the short-window rate predicts exhaustion within 1 hour, it still warns immediately; otherwise, the whole-week average rate must predict exhaustion at least 20% early (`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`) before raising a warning. The interface now displays the time predicted by the whole-week average, eliminating confusing scenarios where "runs out in 8h55m" contradicted the adjacent 5-hour session quota; rules for 5-hour session quota warnings remain unchanged.

items.original: **The weekly quota warning no longer fires from a short burst of use, and the time it shows now matches the reason it fired** ([#138](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/138)). It used to extrapolate only the last 30–60 minutes of burn rate onto the 7-day window, so a dense working session alone could trigger a false alarm (e.g. 53.7% used, 3 days 1 hour to reset, warned "runs out in 13 hours"). `assess_weekly_quota()` now checks both rates: the short window still warns immediately if it alone predicts exhaustion within an hour, but otherwise the whole-week average must predict exhaustion at least 20% of the reset window early (`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`) before it warns — and displays that average's time instead of the short window's, which previously could show a number like "runs out in 8h55m" next to a warning actually driven by a slower week-long trend, contradicting the separate 5-hour session quota shown beside it. Session-quota warnings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣支援 UTF-8 BOM 設定檔，徹底告別卡死與載入中
title.en: Windows system tray supports UTF-8 BOM config files, resolving freezes and endless loading

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦上，當 Claude 設定檔 `~/.claude/settings.json` 帶有 UTF-8 BOM（位元組順序記號，部分編輯器在開頭加入的隱藏標記），系統匣面板不再卡在 `--` 與 Loading。過去 `installer/setup_hook.py` 用一般 `utf-8` 開啟檔案，Python 的解析器把開頭帶 BOM 的有效檔案判為 `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM` 錯誤，導致啟動自我修復步驟在刷新迴圈跑完前就失敗。現在 `_load_settings()` 與舊版遷移邏輯皆改用 `utf-8-sig`，不論檔案有無 BOM 都能正常讀取且設定內容不變。⟦這宛如收發窗口先前看到信件開頭多了一枚印章，就誤判整份合規公文無效而拒絕拆閱；換上相容的判讀方式後，運作才重回正軌。⟧
body.en: On Windows, when Claude's config file `~/.claude/settings.json` contains a UTF-8 BOM (byte order mark, a hidden marker added at the beginning by some editors), the system tray panel no longer gets stuck at `--` and Loading. Previously, `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, causing Python's parser to reject valid files with a BOM with an `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM` error, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop could complete. Now, both `_load_settings()` and the legacy migration logic use `utf-8-sig`, reading the file properly whether a BOM is present or not without altering parsed settings. ⟦This is like a mailroom rejecting a valid official document simply because it has an extra stamp at the top; switching to a compatible reading method puts operations back on track.⟧

items.original: **The Windows tray panel could stay stuck at `--` and Loading forever when `~/.claude/settings.json` had a UTF-8 BOM.** `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, and Python's JSON decoder rejects an otherwise-valid file that starts with a BOM with `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM`, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop ever completed. Both readers (`_load_settings()` and the legacy-usage migration) now open the file as `utf-8-sig`, which accepts the file with or without a BOM and does not change the parsed settings.

title.zh-TW: HTML 報表內建互動日期切換，外寄檔案免裝 app 隨開即查
title.en: HTML reports now feature interactive date filtering, letting recipients explore data instantly without installing an app

body.zh-TW: 將匯出的 HTML 報表寄給同事或主管時，對方現在打開網頁就能自由挑選想看的日期範圍。⟦這好比寄給客戶一張附帶迷你算盤的互動報價單，對方輕撥頂端滑軌，整張單據的各項統計數字便立刻重算。⟧過去報表在產生的那一刻就把區間寫死，收到檔案的人完全無法切換視角；若要改看上週數據，只能請你重跑一次指令。新版直接將約 80 KB 的「日 × 工具 × 模型 × 專案」彙總表嵌入網頁中，所有牽涉日期的區塊都在瀏覽器內即時計算。頁面上方設有吸頂日期列，提供五個快捷範圍與自訂起訖日；不需安裝 app 也不必重新產檔，分享出去的檔案依然能完整操作。至於那些固定觀察特定天數的區塊，介面也會清楚標明涵蓋範圍，避免切換日期時讓人誤以為畫面故障。
body.en: When emailing an exported HTML report to teammates or managers, recipients can now freely select the date range they want to inspect right on the page. ⟦It is like sending a client an interactive quote with a mini abacus attached: they nudge a slider at the top, and all totals across the document instantly recalculate.⟧ Previously, the report locked its timeframe at generation time, leaving recipients unable to adjust the view; switching to last week's numbers meant asking you to rerun the command. The new version directly embeds an ~80 KB summary table of "day × tool × model × project" into the page, and every date-dependent section recalculates live in the browser. A sticky date bar at the top provides five shortcut ranges and a custom from/to range. No app or regeneration is required, keeping shared files fully functional. Sections covering a fixed number of days clearly indicate their span, preventing users from assuming the view is broken when switching dates.

items.original: **The report's date range can be changed inside the page** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)). The HTML report used to freeze its period at generation time, so a copy sent to someone else could not be explored. A day × tool × model × project table (about 80 KB) is now embedded, and every date-dependent section recalculates in the browser from five shortcuts or a custom from/to range in a sticky bar. No app and no regeneration are needed, so a shared file stays fully usable. Sections that always cover a fixed span say so, so they don't look broken when the dates change.

title.zh-TW: 清理對話紀錄不再遺失用量歷史，快照持久化小計與花費
title.en: Cleaning up transcripts no longer erases usage history, with snapshots persisting totals and costs

body.zh-TW: 刪除舊的對話紀錄釋放硬碟空間，歷史報表不再跟著消失。過往報表每次都從 `~/.claude/projects` 與 `~/.codex/sessions` 重算，這些紀錄每月約增長 1.9 GB，清掉舊檔等於抹平歷史。新版將小計以工作階段、日期、工具、模型與專案五個維度存入 `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json` 快照檔，並記錄各工作階段（session）的開始時間與時長，排行榜也能救回。若某天讀取的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）少於快照，當天改由快照還原；已存花費原樣沿用，不依今日價格重新計價。實測今天、本週、最近 7 天、本月與全部五個範圍，模擬紀錄全刪與完整留存產出的報表，除產生時間外逐字相同。⟦這宛如會計部將厚重簽單彙總成分類帳，日後銷毀過期單據，收支與排行依然分毫不差。⟧
body.en: Deleting old conversation transcripts to free up disk space no longer wipes out historical reports. Previously, reports recomputed everything from `~/.claude/projects` and `~/.codex/sessions`, which grow by roughly 1.9 GB each month, so clearing old files meant erasing history. The new version saves subtotal snapshots across five dimensions—session, date, tool, model, and project—into `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json`, while also recording each session's start time and duration so rankings survive. If a given day's loaded tokens are fewer than in the snapshot, that day is restored from the snapshot. Saved costs are kept as-is rather than repriced against today's prices. In tests across five ranges—today, this week, last 7 days, this month, and all—reports generated with transcripts fully kept versus simulated as completely deleted were byte-identical, except for generation time. ⟦This is like an accounting department summarizing heavy receipts into a ledger: even if expired receipts are later shredded, revenue, expenses, and rankings remain exact.⟧

items.original: **Report history survives transcript cleanup.** The report recomputed everything from `~/.claude/projects` and `~/.codex/sessions`, which grow by roughly 1.9 GB a month, so deleting old transcripts erased report history with them. Totals are now kept in `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json` at (session, date, tool, model, project) grain, plus each session's start time and duration so the session ranking survives too. When a day's live transcripts hold fewer tokens than the snapshot, that day is replayed from the snapshot; stored costs are used as-is rather than repriced against today's price list. On real data, reports for today / week / last 7 days / month / all were byte-identical except for the generation time with transcripts present and with all of them simulated as deleted.

title.zh-TW: 報表依閱讀動線重新排版，視覺降噪並最佳化手機瀏覽
title.en: Report layout reorganized around reading flow, reducing visual noise and optimizing mobile viewing

body.zh-TW: 用量報表打開後，版面按閱讀順序重排。⟦像把年報改成目錄，先放總覽，撤掉重複圖表，細節收進可展開頁籤，手機也不迷路。⟧順序是摘要卡、用量趨勢、工具、專案、高花費工作階段、固定週期群組、計算方式、年度回顧。主力模型區塊因重複工具數字而移除；工具列可展開模型，切換日期後保持展開；專案甜甜圈圖因重複排行而刪除。每週燃燒趨勢改名為「用量趨勢」。token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）組成、快取命中率與花費可信度收進折疊的計算卡，五個 fixed range 標籤變成群組上方說明。色條改成底緣 2px 細線，只有 token 數字維持黃色；摘要卡獨立成圓角框，先顯示縮寫數字，下方列精確數字。區塊間距、標題大小與左右邊界也統一，可展開列滑過會高亮。手機上專案一行、工具兩行，工作階段表格橫滑，熱圖保留可讀格子並自動捲到最新週數。開頭摘要移除專案數，因非 git 資料夾與重播歷史會墊高數字。
body.en: When opening the usage report, the layout is now rearranged in reading order. ⟦It is like turning an annual report into a table of contents: leading with the overview, stripping redundant charts, tucking details into expandable tabs, and keeping mobile navigation effortless.⟧ The sequence is now summary cards, usage trend, tools, projects, costliest sessions, fixed-span group, calculation details, and Year in Review. The main model section was removed because it duplicated tool numbers; tool rows can expand to reveal models and remain open after switching dates; the project donut chart was removed for repeating ranking data. "Weekly burn trend" is renamed to "Usage trend". Token composition, cache hit rate, and cost confidence are tucked into a collapsed calculation card, while five "fixed range" tags became a single note above their group. Colored bars were replaced with 2px lines along the bottom edge, with only token figures keeping their yellow color. Summary cards are separate rounded boxes that display abbreviated numbers first, followed by exact figures underneath. Section spacing, heading sizes, and horizontal margins are unified, with expandable rows highlighting on hover. On mobile, projects take one line and tools take two lines, session tables scroll horizontally, and the heatmap retains readable grid cells while automatically scrolling to the latest weeks. The opening summary removes the project count, as non-git folders and replayed history inflate the figure.

items.original:
**The report is reorganised around what people read first.** Order is now summary cards → usage trend → your tools → projects → costliest sessions → the fixed-span group (heatmap, habits, recent work, insights) → how these numbers are calculated → Year in Review. The main-model section repeated the tools section's numbers exactly, so it is gone; each tool row now expands to show its models, and expanded rows stay open when the date range changes. The project donut repeated the ranking below it and was removed. "Weekly burn trend" is now "Usage trend". Token mix, cache hit rate and cost confidence live in a collapsed "How these numbers are calculated" card. The five "fixed range" tags became one note above the group they apply to.
**Visual pass across the report.** Filled bars behind ranking, tool, composition and weekly rows became 2px tracks along the bottom edge; only token figures stay yellow. Summary cards are separate rounded boxes that lead with the abbreviated number and show the exact count underneath. Section spacing and title sizes are consistent, every section shares one left and right edge, and expandable rows highlight on hover. On phones, a project is one line instead of four, a tool is two lines instead of four, the session table scrolls sideways instead of wrapping, and the heatmap keeps readable cells and opens scrolled to the latest weeks.
**The summary sentence no longer states a project count.** Projects are attributed by working folder, so non-git folders and replayed history still inflate the number enough to mislead.

title.zh-TW: 新增每日用量堆疊圖與花費可信度，工具分色不再混淆
title.en: New daily stacked usage chart and cost confidence, with distinct tool colors eliminating confusion

body.zh-TW: 想看清各家 AI 每天的花費與用量節奏，報表新增了直觀的每日用量圖表。圖表每天顯示一根堆疊長條並依工具分色，右上角提供 Tokens 與花費切換開關，滑鼠懸停即可檢視當日用量細項，切換日期時也會跟著重新繪製。為了讓各家工具一目了然，Grok 的代表色改為粉紅色，徹底解決過往綠色與相鄰 Claude 綠色混在一起難以分辨的困擾。此外，報表增設「花費可信度」標記，明確列出有多少比例的用量具備公開價格、多少沒有，並直接點名缺乏公開報價的模型。介面也明白告知讀者，統計顯示的金額是依公開價目表折算的 API 等值花費，並非你的訂閱制月租帳單。⟦這種透明度恰如商務飯店出具的明細單，每天的消費以不同顏色長條清楚區分，附上幣別切換與項目透視，並誠實註記未定價項目的等值折算依據。⟧
body.en: To provide clear visibility into daily spending and usage pacing across different AIs, the report adds an intuitive daily usage chart. The chart displays a stacked bar per day colored by tool, featuring a Tokens/Cost toggle in the top-right corner and hover tooltips for daily breakdowns, automatically redrawing when the date range changes. To make each tool instantly recognizable, Grok's color is changed to pink, resolving the issue where its previous green blended into the adjacent Claude green. In addition, the report introduces a "Cost confidence" badge that specifies the exact proportion of usage backed by public pricing versus unpriced usage, explicitly naming models without public rates. The interface also clearly informs readers that reported costs represent API-equivalent values calculated from public price lists rather than subscription bills. ⟦This transparency is like an itemized hotel invoice where each day's expenses are distinguished by colored bars, complete with currency toggles, line-item breakdowns, and clear explanations for estimated unpriced services.⟧

items.original:
**Daily usage chart.** A stacked bar per day, coloured by tool, with a Tokens/Cost toggle, a hover breakdown, and redraws when the date range changes.
**Cost confidence.** Shows how much usage has a public price and how much does not, names the unpriced models, and states plainly that cost is the API-equivalent value from public price lists, not a subscription bill.
**Grok is pink in the report.** Its previous green sat next to Claude's green in the stacked daily chart and the two could not be told apart.

title.zh-TW: Claude 子目錄工作階段依 Git 歸屬專案，快取擴大防止重複查詢
title.en: Claude sessions in subdirectories attributed to parent repo via Git, with expanded cache preventing repeated lookups

body.zh-TW: 在專案子資料夾啟動 Claude，用量現在會正確歸入同一個母專案。過去 `adapters/claude.py` 處理工作階段（session）只取路徑最後一層名稱，導致 `tests/`、`docs/` 或 `panels/` 都被誤算成獨立專案。新版改用與 Codex、Grok 及 Antigravity 相同的 `resolve_project_name()` 判斷 git 根目錄。為了避免多個工具的資料夾加總後反覆呼叫 `git`，共用快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）上限從 256 筆調升至 2048 筆。只能從小計快照還原的舊日期，則沿用當時記下的資料夾名稱。⟦這彷彿收發室先前只看包裹的辦公室門牌，把同一部門信件拆給不同客戶；改查大樓總地址後，信件才正確歸入同案。⟧
body.en: Launching Claude inside a project subfolder now correctly attributes usage to the same parent project. Previously, `adapters/claude.py` handled sessions by taking only the last folder name in the path, causing `tests/`, `docs/`, or `panels/` to be miscounted as standalone projects. The new version switches to `resolve_project_name()`, matching Codex, Grok, and Antigravity to determine the git root. To avoid repeated `git` calls when aggregating folders across multiple tools, the shared cache limit was raised from 256 to 2048 entries. Older dates that can only be replayed from subtotal snapshots retain the folder names recorded at that time. ⟦It is as if a mailroom previously looked only at office door numbers on packages, sorting letters for the same department into different client bins; checking the building's main address finally routes every mail item to the correct project.⟧

items.original: **Claude sessions opened in a repo subfolder no longer count as separate projects.** `adapters/claude.py` used only the last folder name, so `tests/`, `docs/` and `panels/` each became a project. It now uses the same `resolve_project_name()` git lookup as Codex, Grok and Antigravity, and the shared cache grew from 256 to 2048 entries so several tools' folders together don't push it into repeated `git` calls. Days that can only be replayed from the snapshot keep the folder names recorded at the time.

title.zh-TW: 報表修復排版與圖表比例，校準前期統計與混合計價
title.en: Report fixes layout and chart proportions, calibrating prior-period comparisons and mixed pricing

body.zh-TW: 瀏覽 HTML 報表時，多項版面與統計問題已修正。前期比較不再算到資料起始日之前，排除了如 `↑2799%` 的假成長；工具分組混到未定價模型也不再把整組花費隱藏成 `—`，Antigravity 曾被藏起的 $166 現已正常顯示。因 `.rank-line` 的 `display:grid` 權重高於瀏覽器 `[hidden]` 導致收合失效的問題已排除，收合列會確實收起；`.tokens-cell` 補上 `position:relative`，工作階段（session）排行的長條不再全疊在頁面左上角；展開的模型子列修正尺規，不再把專案佔比套用總量尺度，避免佔專案 68.7% 的模型看起來比專案本身大三倍。⟦這好比校對帳冊排版，校正前後期基準日，把摺疊欄位確實藏起並歸位重疊圖條，不再讓細項畫得比總額還長。⟧
body.en: Several layout and statistical issues in the HTML report have been resolved. Previous-period comparisons no longer reach before the first day of data, eliminating artificial growth spikes such as `↑2799%`. Tool groups mixed with unpriced models no longer hide their entire cost as `—`, properly displaying Antigravity's previously hidden $166. An issue where `.rank-line`'s `display:grid` overrode the browser's `[hidden]` attribute has been fixed, ensuring collapsed rows actually collapse. Adding `position:relative` to `.tokens-cell` prevents session ranking bars from piling up in the top-left corner. Expanded model sub-rows now use corrected scaling rather than plotting project share on the total-volume scale, preventing a model accounting for 68.7% of a project from looking three times larger than the project itself. ⟦This is like proofing a ledger's layout: calibrating baseline comparison dates, properly hiding collapsed rows, repositioning overlapping bars, and preventing sub-items from being drawn longer than the total.⟧

items.original:
**Previous-period comparisons no longer reach before the first day of data** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)), which produced growth like `↑2799%`.
**A tool group with one unpriced model no longer hides its whole cost** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); Antigravity's $166 had been shown as `—`.
**Collapsed rows actually collapse** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)). `.rank-line`'s `display:grid` outranked the browser's `[hidden]`, so collapsing changed the DOM but not the screen.
**Session ranking bars no longer pile up in the top-left corner** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); `.tokens-cell` was missing `position:relative`.
**Expanded model rows are no longer wider than their parent.** Child bars were drawn as share-of-project on the same scale as the parent's share-of-total, so a model at 68.7% of a project looked three times bigger than the project itself.

title.zh-TW: Windows 啟動時不再連閃黑色主控台視窗，子行程全面安靜呼叫
title.en: Windows startup no longer flashes black console windows, child processes fully silenced
