body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 啟動 Usage 時，桌面不再連閃黑色主控台視窗。⟦這好比助手出門採買，每趟都按門鈴吵到客人；改走安靜通道後，前台才重回安寧。⟧usage.exe 打包時無主控台，但呼叫子行程未帶 CREATE_NO_WINDOW，使系統每次都開關黑窗。閃爍次數等於歷史目錄數，因 resolve_project_name() 跑 git worktree list --porcelain。現由 usage_common/subprocess_utils.py 統一為子行程帶旗標與標準輸入 stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL。複製至 ~/.claude/ 的腳本改採內聯實作且經 ast 測試零相依，轉發器補上 FORWARDER_VERSION 與 self_heal()，比照其他 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）自動換新。
body.en: When launching Usage on Windows, the desktop no longer repeatedly flashes black console windows. ⟦This is like an assistant going out for errands and ringing the doorbell every trip, disturbing guests; switching to a quiet hallway restores peace to the front desk.⟧ usage.exe is packaged without a console, but calling child processes did not pass CREATE_NO_WINDOW, causing the system to open and close a black window every time. The flash count equaled the number of history directories because resolve_project_name() runs git worktree list --porcelain. usage_common/subprocess_utils.py now uniformly supplies flags for child processes along with standard input stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL. Scripts copied to ~/.claude/ now use inlined implementations verified by ast tests to have zero dependencies, and the forwarder adds FORWARDER_VERSION and self_heal() to auto-update just like other hooks.

items.original: **No more black console windows flashing at Windows startup** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). `usage.exe` is packaged without a console, but no `subprocess` call in the project passed `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`, so Windows created and closed a console window for every child process. The flash count equalled the number of distinct project directories in the Claude history — `resolve_project_name()` runs `git worktree list --porcelain` once per directory and caches per process, so every launch repeated it. A shared `usage_common/subprocess_utils.py` now supplies the `creationflags`, every child process in the project goes through it, and the missing `stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL` was added along the way. `usage_session_resume.py` and `usage_statusline_forwarder.py` are copied verbatim into `~/.claude/` and run by the system Python, so they keep an inlined equivalent instead of importing the project; a new test uses `ast` to keep every copied-out script free of project imports. The forwarder also had no version-upgrade path at all — `_copy_forwarder_script()` was only called on reinstall or when the state looked broken — so it gained `FORWARDER_VERSION` and a `self_heal()` upgrade step like the other hooks.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板不再先閃現舊位置，單次設定尺寸坐標徹底消除跳動
title.en: Windows panel no longer flashes at old position, single geometry update eliminates jumpiness

body.zh-TW: 點開 Windows 面板時，畫面不再先在舊坐標閃爍一下才跳回定位。pywebview 的 WinForms 後端在 resize() 與 move() 都帶 SWP_SHOWWINDOW，使 _place_window_on_ui_thread() 提早在舊坐標顯示視窗，隨後才移到定點。以 1 毫秒取樣實測，面板在錯位可見 36 毫秒，約兩個畫面幀。現在視窗改在隱藏時以單次 SetWindowPos 一起設定位置與大小且不帶顯示旗標，顯示交由 show() 處理；非 Windows 或取不到原生視窗時退回既有備援流程。套用前也會先比對目前的實體像素幾何，完全相同便跳過，避免 _apply_content_height_now() 在高度未變時白白呼叫。⟦這種穿幫宛如舞台劇換幕，道具桌還留在上一場的站位，工作人員就失手拉開布幕才急忙把它推定位。⟧
body.en: When opening the Windows panel, the screen no longer flashes briefly at its old coordinates before snapping into position. The WinForms backend of pywebview passed SWP_SHOWWINDOW in both resize() and move(), causing _place_window_on_ui_thread() to prematurely display the window at previous coordinates before moving it to its target location. Measured at 1 ms sampling, the panel was visible in the wrong position for 36 ms, or about two frames. The window now sets position and size together via a single SetWindowPos without show flags while hidden, leaving display to show(), and falls back to the existing fallback flow off Windows or when native handles are unavailable. It also compares the current physical-pixel geometry before applying and skips entirely if identical, preventing _apply_content_height_now() from being called unnecessarily when height is unchanged. ⟦This glitch is like a stage scene change where the prop table is still at the previous scene's spot when staff accidentally pull open the curtain before hastily shoving it into place.⟧

items.original: **The Windows panel no longer flashes at its old position before moving.** pywebview's WinForms backend passes `SWP_SHOWWINDOW` in both `resize()` and `move()`, so the `resize()` in `_place_window_on_ui_thread()` made the still-hidden window visible at the previous coordinates; the following `move()` then moved it and only then did `show()` run. Measured at 1 ms sampling, the window sat visible in the wrong place for 36 ms, about two frames. Position and size are now applied while the window is hidden in a single `SetWindowPos` without `SWP_SHOWWINDOW`, leaving display to the existing `show()` path; without a native handle, or off Windows, it falls back to `resize()` + `move()` unchanged. Applying geometry is also skipped entirely when the current physical-pixel geometry already matches, so `_apply_content_height_now()` no longer makes a pointless native call when the content height has not changed.

title.zh-TW: Linux 套件庫全面換用新金鑰，舊安裝需更新金鑰圈
title.en: Linux Package Repositories Switch to New Signing Key, Existing Installs Require Keyring Update

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新或安裝 `gh` 若遇到驗證錯誤，可能是本機尚未登記新印鑑。⟦這好比社區大樓換了新門禁印章，住戶若沒登記新印記，警衛核對舊印鑑就會拒絕放行。⟧ GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與管理軟體的官方倉庫）與個別 RPM 包。它們現在僅以新的 PGP 金鑰（fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`）簽署。若你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前透過官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫安裝 `gh` 且尚未更新金鑰圈（存放信任憑證的鑰匙庫），安裝或升級可能失敗。請依照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換指引更新金鑰圈以排除問題。Windows 與 macOS 使用者，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器及原始碼安裝者，則不受影響。
body.en: If you encounter verification errors when updating or installing `gh` on Linux, your system may not have registered the new stamp yet. ⟦This is like a residential community switching to a new access control stamp; if residents haven't registered the new mark, security checking the old stamp will deny entry.⟧ GitHub CLI's APT and RPM package repositories and individual RPM packages are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`). If you installed `gh` through the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not yet updated your keyring, package installation or upgrades may fail. Follow the official PGP signing key rotation guidance to update your keyring and resolve the issue. Users on Windows and macOS, or those who installed via Homebrew, GitHub Releases, other package managers, or from source, are not affected.

items.original:
## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

title.zh-TW: 登入驗證碼預設自動複製，省下繁瑣手動步驟
title.en: Authentication Codes Copied to Clipboard by Default, Saving Manual Steps

body.zh-TW:
登入 GitHub 帳號或刷新授權時，終端機現在會自動幫你保管驗證碼，省下一道手動複製手續。過去執行 `gh auth login` 登入或 `gh auth refresh` 刷新權限時，畫面會給出一組要在瀏覽器填寫的 OAuth 裝置代碼（在授權網頁輸入以確認本機身分的驗證碼）。以往得手動反白並複製，現在執行這兩項指令時，預設會主動將代碼複製進剪貼簿，切換視窗直接貼上即可。⟦這好比到櫃檯辦業務時，人員直接把號碼牌遞到你手裡，不必自己拿筆在旁邊抄號碼。⟧ 若想永久關閉此功能，可執行設定指令：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

單次呼叫時若有明確指定剪貼簿選項，依然享有最高優先權。
body.en:
When signing in to your GitHub account or refreshing authorization, the terminal now automatically handles the verification code for you, saving a manual copy step. Previously, running `gh auth login` to sign in or `gh auth refresh` to refresh permissions displayed an OAuth device code to be entered in the browser. While you previously had to manually highlight and copy it, running these two commands now copies the code to the clipboard by default, allowing you to switch windows and paste directly. ⟦This is like visiting a service counter where the staff hands the queue slip directly to you, so you don't have to write the number down yourself with a pen.⟧ To permanently disable this feature, run the configuration command:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options specified for an individual invocation still take highest precedence.

items.original:
## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

items.original:
## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.

title.zh-TW: 在命令列直接把截圖和影片附進 issue 與 PR
title.en: Attach screenshots and videos to issues and PRs from the command line

body.zh-TW:
⟦你把沖洗好的照片一張張貼進日誌本，寫到哪一頁就貼在哪一頁；頁面上原本寫著「照片放這裡」的位置，照片會直接蓋上去，其他頁則往後補貼。⟧回報問題時想附一張截圖，以前得先開網頁上傳。現在 `gh` 多了 `--attach`，直接把本機的圖片和影片傳上去，接進 issue、pull request 或留言的內文。

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

內文若已經寫到那個本機路徑，`gh` 會把它換成上傳後的網址；沒寫到就補在最後。同一次指令要附多個檔案，就重複寫幾次這個旗標。這功能在 GitHub.com 與 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 上都能用。

## Attach images and videos to issues and pull requests

The repeatable `--attach` flag uploads local images and videos and adds them to issue, pull request, or comment bodies. If a body already references the local path, `gh` replaces it with the uploaded URL; otherwise it appends the attachment:

```shell
# Attach files when creating or editing an issue
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh issue edit 123 --attach ./walkthrough.mp4

# Attach files when creating or editing a pull request
gh pr create --attach ./before.png
gh pr edit 456 --attach ./after.png

# Attach files to comments
gh issue comment 123 --attach ./repro.png
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

Repeat the flag to attach multiple files in a single invocation. Attachments are available on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

For more information see https://gh.io/gh-attach and https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-github-cli-media-in-issues-pull-requests-and-comments/

title.zh-TW: `gh issue develop` 能另開工作目錄，手上的東西不用收
title.en: `gh issue develop` can check the branch out in a separate worktree

body.zh-TW:
手邊的改動改到一半，issue 那頭又要你開一條新分支——以前得先收拾現場才能切過去。現在 `gh issue develop` 可以幫 issue 建好連動的分支，並且把它簽出到一個新的 Git worktree（工作樹，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），你目前這份工作目錄原封不動。

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦工地要趕另一項工程時，不必把現場拆掉重排，而是在旁邊另闢一塊作業區，兩邊同時進行。⟧
body.en:
You are halfway through a change when an issue needs a fresh branch, and until now you had to tidy up before switching over. `gh issue develop` can now create the linked branch for an issue and check it out in a new Git worktree, a second working copy of the same project that stands on its own, leaving your current working copy untouched.

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦When a site has to start a second job, the crew does not tear down what is already laid out; they open a separate work area beside it and run both at once.⟧

## Worktree support extended to `gh issue develop` 

`gh issue develop` can now create a linked branch and check it out in a new Git worktree, leaving your current working copy unchanged:

```shell
# Create a linked branch for an issue and check it out in a worktree
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```
